samples.original_name: laser welded NiTi – Nb-TC4 alloy components

evidence.quote: Compared with laser welded NiTi – Nb-TC4 alloy components [ 26 ], the strength and toughness of composite WAAM NiTi – Nb-TC4 alloy can be mainly attributed to the following two aspects

Firstly, the NiTi deposition layers were prepared by TIG-WAAM. NiTi alloy repeatedly deposited NiTi substrate to a final height of approximately 22 mm. The optimized TIG-WAAM process parameters during deposition were provided in Table 2 .
Secondly, a layer of Nb was deposited on NiTi by MIG-WAAM system (CMT system).
The process parameters of Nb deposition layer in CMT mode are: current of 152 A, voltage of 13.7 V, moving speed of 0.45 m/min, and wire feed speed of 6.0 m/min.
